_meta.description: Single source of truth for paper numerical values

materials_evaluation._note: Synthetic-data exploration demos; not real predictions

independent_evaluation._note: The earlier harmonized comparison has been removed; use the full independent rerun below (see n_queries).

transfer_evaluation._note: Transfer run against the OQMD-flavored transfer schema (flat layout, renamed columns; see db/transfer_schema.sql); no code changes

transfer_evaluation_variants._note: Transfer/generalization tests A--D; A is same-schema data expansion, B/C are code-unchanged schema transfer, D is lightweight MP adaptation (dedicated prompt plus a small few-shot set)

A_prototype_expansion._note: B2/NaCl/NiAs/BiF$_3$ prototype expansion on the same normalized main schema

B_oqmd_transfer._note: OQMD-flavored flat schema with renamed table and column names (db/transfer_schema.sql)

C_obfuscated._note: Randomized English table/column names preserving FK relationships

D_materials_project._note: Real Materials Project data in a fresh compact schema (see scripts/build_mp_transfer_db.py)

cte_evaluation_15._note: Original CTE patterns (few-shot covered) plus novel zero-shot patterns; counts in n_original / n_novel

figure_source_data._note: Verbatim evaluation JSON payloads consumed by scripts/generate_figures.py

results.sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.number_of_elements = 2
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_a
    WHERE c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND ABS(c_a.atomic_fraction - 0.75) < 1e-6
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_b
    WHERE c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND ABS(c_b.atomic_fraction - 0.25) < 1e-6
  )
ORDER BY m.formula, c.atomic_fraction DESC, c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.element = 'Co'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.crystal_system = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.space_group_number
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.space_group_number = 221
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ti'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.element = 'Pt'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_ni
    WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c_al
    WHERE c_al.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c_al.element = 'Al'
)
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.element = 'Ga'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT c.element, c.site_label
FROM composition c
WHERE c.site_label = 'A-site'
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system
FROM material_entry m
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  s.crystal_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
  (
    s.prototype IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
    OR s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
  )
  AND LOWER(s.crystal_system) = 'cubic'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.element = 'W'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.chemical_system,
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
ORDER BY m.chemical_system ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  s.prototype,
  s.strukturbericht,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Al'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.prototype,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = FALSE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 3.5
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.01
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Ti'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Al-Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.lattice_a < 3.6
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Nb'
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Sc'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system NOT IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       COUNT(*) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element, c.atomic_fraction, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Pd'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.site_label = 'B-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.volume_per_atom <= 12
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ir'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
  AND (ps.is_stable = TRUE OR ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05)
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_a.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  c_b.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
ORDER BY
  c_a.element,
  c_b.element,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  c.element AS a_site,
  AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND cp.value >= 180.0
    AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON m.entry_id = s.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON m.entry_id = ps.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON m.entry_id = c.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    c.element,
    c.site_label,
    c.atomic_fraction,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
    AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS c44, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE s.strukturbericht IN ('L1_2', 'L12', 'L1₂')
  AND (cp.tensor_component = 'C44' OR cp.property_name = 'C44')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.prototype,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

SELECT DISTINCT

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff

SELECT

SELECT

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_compound_count

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT

  s.crystal_system,
  s.space_group_number,
  s.space_group,
  s.prototype,

ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name,
       cp.value,
       cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ca.element AS a_site,
  ca.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
  cb.element AS b_site,
  cb.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction

JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE ca.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND ca.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND cb.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND cb.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L1₂', 'L12', 'L1_2')
ORDER BY m.formula, ca.element, cb.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS "C11",
  cp_c12.value AS "C12",
  cp_c44.value AS "C44"
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_tensor'
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_tensor'
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_tensor'
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
  AND cp_c44.value > 0
  AND cp_c11.value + 2 * cp_c12.value > 0
ORDER BY
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC,
  cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c_ni
      WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c_co
      WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c_co.element = 'Co'
    )
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  (
    0.4 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)) +
    0.3 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) +
    0.3 * (cp.value / 200.0)
  ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap, cp.property_name, cp.value, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label IN ('A-site', 'B-site')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC,
         ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC,
         cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE
    (m.formula = 'Co3Ti' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0 THEN 'Q1: formation_energy < 0 / energy_above_hull <= 0'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull > 0 THEN 'Q2: formation_energy < 0 / energy_above_hull > 0'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0 THEN 'Q3: formation_energy >= 0 / energy_above_hull <= 0'
    ELSE 'Q4: formation_energy >= 0 / energy_above_hull > 0'
  END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY stability_quadrant, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system NOT IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d'
    WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d/5d'
  END AS transition_metal_series,
  c.element,
  c.site_label,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND s.strukturbericht IN ('L12', 'L1_2', 'L1₂')
  AND c.element IN (
    'Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg'
  )
ORDER BY transition_metal_series ASC, ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull < (
      SELECT ps_ref.energy_above_hull
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE (m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.formula = 'AlNi3' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'AlNi3')
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      ORDER BY ps_ref.energy_above_hull ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
           AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      WHERE (m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.formula = 'AlNi3' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'AlNi3')
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND NOT (m.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m.formula = 'AlNi3' OR m.reduced_formula = 'AlNi3')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0)) AS stability_score,
    1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_match_score,
    cp_bm.value AS elastic_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0)))
    * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
    * cp_bm.value AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.element = 'Ni'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.1
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m

  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_al_l12_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS unstable_al_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = FALSE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    m.source_db,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.lattice_a,
    s.lattice_b,
    s.lattice_c,
    s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name,
       cp.value,
       cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.is_stable,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC,
         ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
         ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_a.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  c_b.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula, c_a.element, c_b.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND string_to_array(m.chemical_system, '-') && ARRAY[
    'Sc','Ti','V','Cr','Mn','Fe','Co','Ni','Cu','Zn',
    'Y','Zr','Nb','Mo','Tc','Ru','Rh','Pd','Ag','Cd',
    'Hf','Ta','W','Re','Os','Ir','Pt','Au','Hg',
    'Rf','Db','Sg','Bh','Hs','Mt','Ds','Rg','Cn'
  ]
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS C11,
  cp_c12.value AS C12,
  cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11
  ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
 AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12
  ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
 AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44
  ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
 AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (cp_c11.value - cp_c12.value) > 0
  AND (cp_c11.value + 2 * cp_c12.value) > 0
  AND cp_c44.value > 0
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, lattice_diff ASC, cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_a_deviation_from_ni3al
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    (
        0.4 * (CASE WHEN ps.is_stable THEN 1.0 ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull) END)
        + 0.3 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
        + 0.3 * (cp.value / 300.0)
    ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, lattice_diff ASC, bulk_modulus DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.is_stable,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
      EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Ni'
      )
      OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM composition c
          WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
            AND c.element = 'Co'
      )
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  COUNT(*) AS material_count,
  AVG(c_a.atomic_fraction) AS avg_a_site_atomic_fraction,
  AVG(c_b.atomic_fraction) AS avg_b_site_atomic_fraction,
  AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.value / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS ranking_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ranking_score DESC, lattice_diff ASC, bulk_modulus DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY
    ps.is_stable DESC,
    ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC,
    cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
WHERE
    (m.formula = 'Co3Ti' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Co3Ti')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q1: negative formation energy / stable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q2: negative formation energy / metastable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q3: positive formation energy / stable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q4: positive formation energy / metastable'
  END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.energy_above_hull IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY stability_quadrant, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
  (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC,
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d transition metal'
    WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d/5d transition metal'
  END AS a_site_transition_metal_period,
  c.element AS a_site,
  m.formula,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND (
    c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn')
    OR c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
  )
ORDER BY a_site_transition_metal_period ASC, c.element ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
      SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
      ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
           AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)) AS stability_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) AS lattice_matching_score,
    cp.value AS elastic_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull))
    * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
    * cp.value AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m

WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group

    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  ca.element AS a_element,

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula

SELECT DISTINCT

    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula, s.crystal_system

ORDER BY m.formula

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY m.formula

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula,

  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'

      SELECT ps_ref.energy_above_hull

SELECT
    ranked.formula,
    ranked.is_stable,
    ranked.energy_above_hull,
    ranked.lattice_a,
    ranked.lattice_diff,
    ranked.c11,
    ranked.c12,
    ranked.c44,
    ranked.stability_score,
    ranked.lattice_match_score,
    ranked.elastic_score,
    ranked.stability_score * ranked.lattice_match_score * ranked.elastic_score AS composite_score
FROM (
    SELECT
        m.formula,
        ps.is_stable,
        ps.energy_above_hull,
        s.lattice_a,
        ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
        cp_c11.value AS c11,
        cp_c12.value AS c12,
        cp_c44.value AS c44,
        1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0)) AS stability_score,
        1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_match_score,
        CASE
            WHEN cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value AND cp_c44.value > 0
            THEN (cp_c11.value - cp_c12.value + 3.0 * cp_c44.value) / 5.0
            ELSE 0.0
        END AS elastic_score
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c11.property_name = 'C11'
    JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c12.property_name = 'C12'
    JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
        AND cp_c44.property_name = 'C44'
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
) ranked
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
  AND cp_c44.value > 0
  AND cp_c11.value + 2 * cp_c12.value > 0
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c_ni
      WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c_ni.element = 'Ni'
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c_co
      WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c_co.element = 'Co'
    )
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.is_stable,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
       (
         0.4 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)) +
         0.3 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) +
         0.3 * (cp.value / 300.0)
       ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT

    ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q1: negative formation energy / stable'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q2: negative formation energy / metastable'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q3: positive formation energy / stable'
        WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q4: positive formation energy / metastable'
    END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY stability_quadrant, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d transition metal'
    WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                       'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d/5d transition metal'
  END AS a_site_transition_series,
  c.element AS a_site,
  m.formula,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
ORDER BY a_site_transition_series ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.is_stable,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       s.lattice_a,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
      SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
        AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,

       ps.is_stable,

JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)) AS stability_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) AS lattice_match_score,
    (cp_bm.value / (cp_bm.value + 100.0)) AS elastic_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull))
    * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
    * (cp_bm.value / (cp_bm.value + 100.0)) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,

       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       (
         0.5 * CASE WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END
         - 0.3 * ps.energy_above_hull
         - 0.2 * ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)
         + 0.001 * cp_bm.value
       ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.is_stable,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       s.lattice_a,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
      SELECT ps.formation_energy_per_atom
      FROM material_entry m
      JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
      JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
      WHERE (m.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
        AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp.value
      FROM material_entry m
      JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
      JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
           AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS C11,
  cp_c12.value AS C12,
  cp_c44.value AS C44,
  (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)) AS stability_score,
  (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) AS lattice_matching_score,
  ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0) AS elastic_score,
  (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull))
    * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
    * ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull

SELECT

  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS C11,
  cp_c12.value AS C12,
  cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
  AND cp_c11.value > cp_c12.value
  AND cp_c44.value > 0
ORDER BY
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC,
  cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

FROM material_entry m

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT

    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    (
        0.4 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull))
        + 0.3 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
        + 0.3 * (cp.value / 300.0)
    ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q2: negative formation energy / metastable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q3: positive formation energy / stable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q4: positive formation energy / metastable'
  END AS stability_quadrant
FROM material_entry m

    WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                       'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d/5d transition metal'
  END AS transition_metal_group,

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
      SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      ORDER BY ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
           AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'
        AND (s_ref.prototype = 'L12' OR s_ref.strukturbericht = 'L12')
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
        ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0))
    END AS stability_score,
    1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_matching_score,
    cp.value AS elastic_score,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + GREATEST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.0))
        END
        * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
        * cp.value
    ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a

SELECT

SELECT m.formula,

SELECT

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.is_stable

SELECT

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_a_diff_from_ni3al, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

SELECT

FROM material_entry m

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT

  s.lattice_b,
  s.lattice_c,
  s.volume_per_atom,

FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula ASC

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name,
       cp.value,
       cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.is_stable,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.is_stable,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       s.lattice_a,

FROM material_entry m

JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id

  (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ('-' || m.chemical_system || '-') ~ '-(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg)-'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS C11,
  cp_c12.value AS C12,
  cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp_c11.value > 0
  AND cp_c12.value > 0
  AND cp_c44.value > 0
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp.value AS bulk_modulus,
    (
        0.4 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)) +
        0.3 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) +
        0.3 * (cp.value / (cp.value + 100.0))
    ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q3: nonnegative formation energy / stable'

SELECT m.formula,

JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < (
      SELECT ps_ref.formation_energy_per_atom
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al'

      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN structure s_ref ON s_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
           AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44,
    CASE
        WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
        ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)
    END AS stability_score,
    1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) AS lattice_matching_score,
    (cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0 AS elastic_score,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 1.0
            ELSE 1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)
        END
        * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
        * ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0)
    ) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;
