SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Co'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 3.5
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, s.prototype
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.01
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ti'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.prototype, s.strukturbericht
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.chemical_system = 'Al-Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND s.lattice_a < 3.6
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Nb'
  )
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Sc'
  )
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system NOT IN ('Al-Ni', 'Ni-Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS l12_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY l12_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  c.element,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
  c.element = 'Pd'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  CASE
    WHEN ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'stable'
    ELSE 'unstable'
  END AS stability,
  ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    c.site_label = 'B-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.volume_per_atom <= 12
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ir'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements = 2
ORDER BY m.chemical_system, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Ni'
  )
  AND (
    ps.is_stable = TRUE
    OR (ps.is_stable = FALSE AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05)
  )
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ca.element AS a_site,
       ca.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
       cb.element AS b_site,
       cb.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition ca ON ca.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ca.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND cb.site_label = 'B-site'
ORDER BY ca.element, cb.element, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  s.lattice_a,
  ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a IS NOT NULL
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY c.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.unit = 'GPa'
  AND cp.value >= 180
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_a_difference_to_ni3al, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Co'
      AND c.atomic_fraction >= 0.5
  )
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       c.element AS b_site,
       c.atomic_fraction,
       ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS shear_modulus, cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND LOWER(cp.property_name) LIKE '%bulk%modulus%'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC, cp.value ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
    m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, s.lattice_a, s.space_group, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.band_gap
FROM material_entry m
    JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
    AND c.site_label = 'A-site'

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) <= 0.05
ORDER BY cp.value DESC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS stable_l12_al_count,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS unstable_l12_al_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND c.element = 'Al'
  )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = FALSE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_l12_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_l12_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    m.source_db,
    s.prototype,
    s.strukturbericht,
    s.crystal_system,
    s.space_group_number,
    s.space_group,
    s.lattice_a,
    s.lattice_b,
    s.lattice_c,
    s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name,
       cp.value,
       cp.unit
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name IN ('C11', 'C12', 'C44')
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
  AND cp.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT
  m.formula,
  c_a.element AS a_site,
  c_a.atomic_fraction AS a_site_atomic_fraction,
  c_b.element AS b_site,
  c_b.atomic_fraction AS b_site_atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula, c_a.element, c_b.element
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system ~ '(^|-)(Sc|Ti|V|Cr|Mn|Fe|Co|Ni|Cu|Zn|Y|Zr|Nb|Mo|Tc|Ru|Rh|Pd|Ag|Cd|Hf|Ta|W|Re|Os|Ir|Pt|Au|Hg|Rf|Db|Sg|Bh|Hs|Mt|Ds|Rg|Cn)(-|$)'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
  m.formula,
  ps.is_stable,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  s.lattice_a,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
  cp_c11.value AS C11,
  cp_c12.value AS C12,
  cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements >= 2
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY
  ps.energy_above_hull ASC,
  ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC,
  cp_c44.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0
  AND m.formula <> 'Ni3Al'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM composition c
      WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
        AND c.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  )
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC, ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.is_stable,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
    (
        0.4 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)) +
        0.3 * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) +
        0.3 * (cp_bm.value / 300.0)
    ) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')

LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula,

      EXISTS (

SELECT c_a.element AS a_site,

       COUNT(*) AS material_count,
       AVG(ps.energy_above_hull) AS avg_energy_above_hull,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS stable_percentage,
       AVG(c_a.atomic_fraction) AS avg_a_site_atomic_fraction,
       AVG(c_b.atomic_fraction) AS avg_b_site_atomic_fraction
FROM material_entry m

JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'

ORDER BY stable_percentage DESC, avg_energy_above_hull ASC, material_count DESC

SELECT m.formula,

SELECT

    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q2: negative formation energy / unstable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = TRUE THEN 'Q3: positive formation energy / stable'
    WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom >= 0 AND ps.is_stable = FALSE THEN 'Q4: positive formation energy / unstable'
  END AS quadrant
FROM material_entry m

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn') THEN '3d'
    WHEN c.element IN ('Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                       'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg') THEN '4d/5d'
  END AS transition_metal_series,
  c.element AS a_site,
  m.formula,
  c.atomic_fraction,
  ps.energy_above_hull,
  ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id

  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                    'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd',
                    'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg')
ORDER BY transition_metal_series ASC, c.element ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull < (
      SELECT ps_ref.energy_above_hull
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al'
      ORDER BY ps_ref.energy_above_hull ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
           AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al'
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND NOT (m.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m

WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)) AS stability_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) AS lattice_matching_score,
    ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0) AS elastic_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull))
    * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
    * ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ti'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system = 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT fh.formula, fh.lattice_a
FROM formation_enthalpy fh
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = fh.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND fh.is_stable = true
  AND fh.lattice_a < 3.6
ORDER BY fh.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c.element = 'Nb')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Sc'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, m.chemical_system, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.lattice_a >= 4.0
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, s.prototype, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c.element = 'Pd')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Cu'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.is_stable DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.site_label = 'B-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND s.volume_per_atom <= 12
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ir'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.chemical_system, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.number_of_elements = 2
GROUP BY m.chemical_system
ORDER BY count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT fh.formula, s.lattice_a, fh.is_stable
FROM formation_enthalpy fh
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = fh.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND fh.is_stable = true
ORDER BY s.lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.1
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c.element = 'Ni')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT ca.element AS a_site, cb.element AS b_site, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition ca ON ca.entry_id = m.entry_id AND ca.site_label = 'A-site'
JOIN composition cb ON cb.entry_id = m.entry_id AND cb.site_label = 'B-site'
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ca.element, cb.element, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_ni WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_ni.element = 'Ni')
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_co WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_co.element = 'Co'))
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site, AVG(s.lattice_a) AS avg_lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_lattice_a DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT fh.formula, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM formation_enthalpy fh
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = fh.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom <= -0.3
  AND s.lattice_a BETWEEN 3.5 AND 3.7
ORDER BY fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_bm.value >= 180
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c.element = 'Co')
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), ps.energy_above_hull
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, c.element AS b_site, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, et.shear_modulus_vrh
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY et.shear_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Ni'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site, AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_eform
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_energy
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.55) < 0.05
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE m.formula IN ('Co3Ti', 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = TRUE) AS count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ps.is_stable = FALSE) AS unstable_count
FROM 
    material_entry m
JOIN 
    structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN 
    phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE 
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM composition c 
        WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c.element = 'Al'
    )
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS b_site, COUNT(DISTINCT m.entry_id) AS stable_compound_count
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY stable_compound_count DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, s.lattice_b, s.lattice_c, s.volume_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull, et.bulk_modulus_vrh, et.shear_modulus_vrh, et.youngs_modulus, et.poisson_ratio, tp.debye_temperature_k, tp.thermal_conductivity, tp.specific_heat_cv, mp.total_magnetization, mp.curie_temperature_k
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
LEFT JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
LEFT JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
LEFT JOIN thermal_property tp ON tp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
LEFT JOIN magnetic_property mp ON mp.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND calc.functional = 'GGA-PBE'
  AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ps.is_stable,
       cp.property_name, cp.value
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE c.element = 'Fe'
  AND (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY m.formula, cp.property_name
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
  AND cp_bm.value >= 160
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT DISTINCT m.formula, c_a.element AS a_site, c_b.element AS b_site
FROM material_entry m
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
  AND c_a.element IN ('Ni', 'Co')
  AND c_b.element IN ('Al', 'Ti')
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.volume_per_atom, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY s.volume_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT
    m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM
    material_entry m
JOIN
    structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN
    phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE
    (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    AND ps.energy_above_hull = 0
    AND ps.formation_energy_per_atom <= -0.4
ORDER BY
    ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.prototype, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM composition c
    JOIN element e ON e.symbol = c.element
    WHERE c.entry_id = m.entry_id
      AND e.block = 'd'
  )
ORDER BY m.formula
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
       et.bulk_modulus_vrh, et.shear_modulus_vrh, et.poisson_ratio
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull, lattice_diff, et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a, cp_c11.value AS C11, cp_c12.value AS C12, cp_c44.value AS C44
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id AND cp_c11.property_name = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id AND cp_c12.property_name = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id AND cp_c44.property_name = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_ni WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_ni.element = 'Ni')
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_co WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_co.element = 'Co'))
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom, s.lattice_a, cp_c11.value, cp_c12.value, cp_c44.value
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       (0.5 * (1 - ps.energy_above_hull) + 0.3 * (1 - ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)) + 0.2 * cp_bm.value) AS weighted_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY weighted_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_ni WHERE c_ni.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_ni.element = 'Ni')
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM composition c_co WHERE c_co.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_co.element = 'Co'))
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT c_a.element AS a_site, c_b.element AS b_site,
       COUNT(*) AS total_combinations,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ps.is_stable THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stable_combinations
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c_a ON c_a.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_a.site_label = 'A-site'
JOIN composition c_b ON c_b.entry_id = m.entry_id AND c_b.site_label = 'B-site'
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
GROUP BY c_a.element, c_b.element
ORDER BY total_combinations DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.001
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC, cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull,
       et.bulk_modulus_vrh, et.shear_modulus_vrh,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY lattice_mismatch ASC, et.bulk_modulus_vrh DESC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.element = 'Co'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

WITH compound AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE m.formula = 'Co3Ti'
    LIMIT 1
),
ref_energies AS (
    SELECT c.entry_id,
           SUM(comp.atomic_fraction * per.energy_per_atom) AS weighted_ref
    FROM compound c
    JOIN composition comp ON comp.entry_id = c.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = comp.element
    GROUP BY c.entry_id
)
SELECT c.formula,
       c.formation_energy_per_atom,
       r.weighted_ref AS ref_energy,
       c.formation_energy_per_atom - r.weighted_ref AS corrected_enthalpy
FROM compound c
JOIN ref_energies r ON r.entry_id = c.entry_id;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom, ps.energy_above_hull
FROM material_entry m

JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY ps.formation_energy_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.energy_above_hull,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
ORDER BY lattice_mismatch ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, et.bulk_modulus_vrh, s.lattice_a
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation cal_et ON cal_et.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN elastic_tensor et ON et.calculation_id = cal_et.calculation_id
WHERE s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12'
ORDER BY et.bulk_modulus_vrh ASC, s.lattice_a ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site, ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN element e ON e.symbol = c.element
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
  AND e.block IN ('d')
  AND e.period_number IN (4, 5, 6)
ORDER BY e.period_number, e.atomic_number
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, ps.energy_above_hull, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull < 0.0
ORDER BY cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT fh.formula, fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom, fh.corrected_formation_enthalpy, fh.lattice_a
FROM formation_enthalpy fh
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = fh.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND fh.is_stable = true
  AND fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom < -0.3
ORDER BY fh.formation_enthalpy_ev_per_atom ASC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT m.formula, 
       ps.energy_above_hull, 
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff, 
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       (1 / (1 + ps.energy_above_hull)) * (1 / (1 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) * cp_bm.value AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

SELECT c.element AS a_site,
       AVG(ps.formation_energy_per_atom) AS avg_formation_enthalpy
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN composition c ON c.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND c.site_label = 'A-site'
GROUP BY c.element
ORDER BY avg_formation_enthalpy
LIMIT 10000;

WITH all_l12 AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
),
enthalpy AS (
    SELECT al.entry_id, al.formula, al.formation_energy_per_atom,
           SUM(comp.atomic_fraction * per.energy_per_atom) AS weighted_ref
    FROM all_l12 al
    JOIN composition comp ON comp.entry_id = al.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = comp.element
    GROUP BY al.entry_id, al.formula, al.formation_energy_per_atom
),
ni_bearing AS (
    SELECT e.entry_id, e.formula,
           e.formation_energy_per_atom - e.weighted_ref AS delta_h_f
    FROM enthalpy e
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM composition c WHERE c.entry_id = e.entry_id AND c.element = 'Ni'
    )
)
SELECT formula, ROUND(delta_h_f::numeric, 4) AS corrected_enthalpy
FROM ni_bearing
ORDER BY delta_h_f ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH corrected AS (
    SELECT m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
           SUM(comp.atomic_fraction * per.energy_per_atom) AS weighted_ref
    FROM material_entry m
    JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN composition comp ON comp.entry_id = m.entry_id
    JOIN pure_element_reference per ON per.element_symbol = comp.element
    JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
    WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
    GROUP BY m.entry_id, m.formula, ps.formation_energy_per_atom
)
SELECT formula,
       ROUND(formation_energy_per_atom::numeric, 4) AS raw_e_form,
       ROUND(weighted_ref::numeric, 4) AS weighted_ref,
       ROUND((formation_energy_per_atom - weighted_ref)::numeric, 4) AS corrected_e_form
FROM corrected
WHERE (formation_energy_per_atom - weighted_ref) < -0.1
ORDER BY (formation_energy_per_atom - weighted_ref) ASC
LIMIT 10000;

  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'

failures.question: Ni基超合金のγ'相代替候補として、Ni-Al系以外で安定なL1₂化合物を格子整合性で評価して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT
    m.formula,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    ps.is_stable
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.is_stable = TRUE
  AND m.chemical_system != 'Al-Ni'
ORDER BY lattice_diff ASC, ps.energy_above_hull ASC
LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS mismatch,
       (1.0 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
       + (1.0 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.25
       + (LEAST(cp_bm.value, 300) / 300.0) * 0.25
       + (CASE WHEN ps.formation_energy_per_atom < -0.3 THEN 0.20 ELSE 0.10 END) AS design_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY design_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;

failures.question: L1₂化合物のうちNi3Alより安定でバルクモジュラスが高い候補を出して。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT m.formula, ps.is_stable, ps.energy_above_hull, cp.value AS bulk_modulus
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp ON cp.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
     AND cp.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull < (
      SELECT ps_ref.energy_above_hull
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN phase_stability ps_ref ON ps_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al'
      ORDER BY ps_ref.energy_above_hull ASC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND cp.value > (
      SELECT cp_ref.value
      FROM material_entry m_ref
      JOIN calculation calc_ref ON calc_ref.entry_id = m_ref.entry_id
      JOIN calculated_property cp_ref ON cp_ref.calculation_id = calc_ref.calculation_id
           AND cp_ref.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
      WHERE m_ref.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m_ref.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al'
      ORDER BY cp_ref.value DESC
      LIMIT 1
  )
  AND NOT (m.formula = 'Ni3Al' OR m.reduced_formula = 'Ni3Al')
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, cp.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT m.formula,
       s.lattice_a,
       ps.energy_above_hull,
       cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       cp_sm.value AS shear_modulus,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS mismatch
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
JOIN calculated_property cp_sm ON cp_sm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
  AND cp_sm.property_name = 'shear_modulus'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND ps.energy_above_hull <= 0.05
ORDER BY ps.energy_above_hull ASC, cp_bm.value DESC
LIMIT 10000;

failures.question: 全L1₂化合物について、安定性スコア×格子整合性スコア×弾性スコアの複合スコアを計算してランキングして。
failures.gen_sql:
SELECT
    m.formula,
    ps.energy_above_hull,
    s.lattice_a,
    ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS lattice_diff,
    cp_c11.value AS C11,
    cp_c12.value AS C12,
    cp_c44.value AS C44,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull)) AS stability_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57))) AS lattice_matching_score,
    ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0) AS elastic_score,
    (1.0 / (1.0 + ps.energy_above_hull))
    * (1.0 / (1.0 + ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57)))
    * ((cp_c11.value + cp_c12.value + cp_c44.value) / 3.0) AS composite_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_c11 ON cp_c11.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c11.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c11.tensor_component = 'C11'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c12 ON cp_c12.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c12.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c12.tensor_component = 'C12'
JOIN calculated_property cp_c44 ON cp_c44.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
    AND cp_c44.property_name = 'elastic_constant'
    AND cp_c44.tensor_component = 'C44'
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
ORDER BY composite_score DESC
LIMIT 10000;
failures.gold_sql:
SELECT m.formula, s.lattice_a, ps.formation_energy_per_atom,
       ps.energy_above_hull, cp_bm.value AS bulk_modulus,
       ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57) AS mismatch,
       (1.0 - LEAST(ps.energy_above_hull, 0.05) / 0.05) * 0.30
       + (1.0 - LEAST(ABS(s.lattice_a - 3.57), 0.3) / 0.3) * 0.30
       + (LEAST(cp_bm.value, 300) / 300.0) * 0.20
       + (-ps.formation_energy_per_atom / 1.0) * 0.20 AS final_score
FROM material_entry m
JOIN structure s ON s.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN phase_stability ps ON ps.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculation calc ON calc.entry_id = m.entry_id
JOIN calculated_property cp_bm ON cp_bm.calculation_id = calc.calculation_id
WHERE (s.prototype = 'L12' OR s.strukturbericht = 'L12')
  AND cp_bm.property_name = 'bulk_modulus'
ORDER BY final_score DESC
LIMIT 20;
